fusions.name: Log on a Vine
fusions.desc: Cuts loose a log slung on a vine that deals 14 damage to a target up to 6 tiles away, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Cached Throwing Stones
fusions.desc: Hurls 3 stones from a hidden cache in a spread out to 6 tiles. Each stone deals 3 damage, with a 20% chance to leave the target [Stunned] for 1 second. The cache holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Dangled Fruit
fusions.desc: Dangles bait and beats your chest: up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles are drawn onto you for 4 seconds, and you take 20% less damage for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Grips Back
fusions.desc: Each time you put a condition on an enemy, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
